_doc: Optional MCP servers. Enable with `bin/stack mcp enable <name>` (copies the entry into .mcp.json and settings approvals); disable with `bin/stack mcp disable <name>`. OAuth servers authenticate via /mcp inside Claude Code.

fal._note: fal's hosted MCP (~60 tools: search_models, run_model, submit_jobs, create_entity for reusable characters/styles from 1-20 refs). Key-header auth accepted for initialize/tools/list on probe; the documented route is OAuth via https://mcp.fal.ai/mcp-relay. Cannot read local paths (use upload_file).

replicate._note: official local Replicate MCP; reads REPLICATE_API_TOKEN

recraft._note: official remote Recraft MCP (OAuth, subscription credits): generate_image incl. _vector models, vectorize_image, remove_background, crisp_upscale

flux._note: official Black Forest Labs MCP (OAuth): FLUX.2 generate/variations

peekaboo._note: open-source macOS computer use (accessibility-tree first). Needs Screen Recording + Accessibility for the app running Claude Code. Use when the built-in computer-use server is unavailable (e.g. headless/-p runs).

markitdown._note: Microsoft markitdown: convert_to_markdown(uri) for PDFs/Office/HTML, run with uvx on Python 3.14

indesign._note: InDesign (community, MIT: github.com/nutriandrea/adobe-indesign-mcp, npm indesign-nutria-mcp, ~190 tools). InDesign must be running; talks to a UXP bridge panel over ws://localhost:8120. Optional INDESIGN_APP in stack.env (e.g. "Adobe InDesign 2026") for the plugin-free macOS JXA proxy.
indesign._setup: automated by ./install.sh --adobe indesign (stack/adobe.py); by hand: load the repo's plugin/ 'MCP Bridge' UXP panel in InDesign via Adobe UXP Developer Tool (Add Plugin > manifest.json > Load), or set INDESIGN_APP in ~/.claude/stack.env to use the macOS JXA proxy

illustrator._note: Illustrator (community, MIT: github.com/ie3jp/illustrator-mcp-server, ~66 tools) driving Illustrator 2024+ through ExtendScript; Illustrator must be running. Adobe also ships an official MCP inside Illustrator Beta 30.4+ (settings give a URL + key, connect with mcp-remote).
illustrator._setup: automated by ./install.sh --adobe illustrator (stack/adobe.py); by hand: none beyond a running Illustrator 2024+; allow automation of Illustrator when macOS asks

photoshop._note: Photoshop 26+ (community, MIT: github.com/mikechambers/adb-mcp, its most complete target). Needs the adb-mcp clone, its Node proxy (ws://localhost:3001) running, and the UXP plugin connected in Photoshop. The same repo has pr/id/ai/ae scripts if you prefer one stack for every app.
photoshop._setup: automated by ./install.sh --adobe photoshop (stack/adobe.py); by hand: git clone https://github.com/mikechambers/adb-mcp ~/.claude/stack-data/adobe/adb-mcp; keep `node ~/.claude/stack-data/adobe/adb-mcp/adb-proxy-socket/proxy.js` running; UXP Developer Tool > Add Plugin > uxp/ps/manifest.json > Load, then Connect in the panel (reload after each Photoshop restart)

after-effects._note: After Effects 2022+ (community, MIT: github.com/Dakkshin/after-effects-mcp). Not on npm: runs from a local clone and an ExtendScript bridge panel; After Effects must be running. Adobe's official connectors do not cover After Effects.
after-effects._setup: automated by ./install.sh --adobe after-effects (stack/adobe.py); by hand: git clone https://github.com/Dakkshin/after-effects-mcp ~/.claude/stack-data/adobe/after-effects-mcp && cd it && npm install && npm run build && npm run install-bridge; in After Effects open Window > mcp-bridge-auto.jsx and tick 'Auto-run commands'

premiere-pro._note: Premiere Pro (community, MIT: github.com/leancoderkavy/premiere-pro-mcp, npm premiere-pro-mcp, ~440 tools) over a CEP panel; Premiere must be running, Node 20.19+, FFmpeg for trim/slip. Optional PREMIERE_MCP_CAPABILITIES in stack.env (inspect,edit,export,filesystem,unsafe-script) narrows what it may do. Stdio only; its HTTP mode binds 0.0.0.0.
premiere-pro._setup: automated by ./install.sh --adobe premiere-pro (stack/adobe.py); by hand: install the package's CEP panel (artifacts/MCPBridgeCEP.zxp, see the repo README), then in Premiere open Window > Extensions > 'MCP for Adobe Premiere Pro'; brew install ffmpeg for trim/slip
